messages.snippet: Dear Clerks, We should like to arrange a conference with Catherine Rosenthal KC to settle Particular
messages.subject: Conference with Ms Rosenthal KC - Bracken/Calderwood
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Clerks,

We should like to arrange a conference with Catherine Rosenthal KC to settle Particulars of Claim in Bracken Group plc v Calderwood Industries Ltd. Could you offer some availability in the week commencing 13 October, in person at Eldon Chambers? Attending for the firm will be Sarah Whitfield and Tom Gallagher.

With thanks,
Donna Bridges
Practice Assistant, Whitfield Carter LLP
